title: Checksum generator foreach variable collides case-insensitively with typed PackDirectory parameter
actual: MariaDB manifests remain unchanged; execution reaches PostgreSQL discovery and exits because property FullName is unavailable on the coerced string loop value.
rootCause: PowerShell variable names are case-insensitive. The loop variable packDirectory aliases the typed string[] parameter PackDirectory, so DirectoryInfo assignments are coerced to string before .FullName is read.
repair: The discovered DirectoryInfo loop now uses a name distinct from the public typed parameter; the public PackDirectory contract is unchanged and a source regression forbids reintroducing the alias.
verification: Exact command iterates all 18 PostgreSQL/Oracle pack directories plus both MariaDB owners and exits 0; targeted suite passes 23/23; complete checksum gate passes.
